caption:
In 2000, Netflix was losing money and offered to sell itself to Blockbuster for $50 million.

Blockbuster declined. Twenty-six years later the company that said no is gone and the one that asked is worth hundreds of billions.

The decision was not stupid at the time. That is the part worth studying.

Sources: Newsweek fact check, 11 Mar 2021, citing Reed Hastings and Marc Randolph's accounts; Blockbuster's then-CEO disputes that serious talks happened.
